title: PRD Addendum — Add-Position Flow and Active-Position Lock (D14/D15)

sections.heading: Change Record
sections.body: markdown: addendum v1.0 extends PRD v2 after owner decisions D14/D15 (2026-10-30); no legacy FR altered; FR-01..FR-24 remain owned by PRD_DK_Bond_Tracker_v2

sections.heading: Add-Position Flow (D14)
sections.body: The user adds a company/position exactly ONCE, through the Watch List add form (fields: company, ISIN, amount, tenure, start month). That submission creates ONE bonds master row per position. The monthly grid, the dashboard, and the watch list all render from that same row — company and position details are never entered a second time anywhere in the app. The legacy workbook's pattern of duplicating the same bond across two sheets is replaced by this single-master flow; adding a position is a single write, and every surface reads the same stored row.

sections.heading: Active-Position Lock (D15)
sections.body:
At most ONE active (On-going or Danger) position may exist per company. The duplicate match key is the normalized company name (trimmed, case-insensitive) OR the ISIN: a new add is blocked if EITHER key matches an active position. Enforcement is a HARD BLOCK with a named error that identifies the blocking position and its status (surfaced per FR-21); there is no override and no force-accept. The lock releases ONLY when the existing position reaches Completed (D5: months paid >= tenure). A new position bought after Completed starts On-going and re-locks the company until it too completes.

State example:
- Company Muthoottu has an active position (On-going) -> adding another Muthoottu position (by name or ISIN) is BLOCKED with a named error.
- That position reaches Completed (months paid >= tenure) -> adding a new Muthoottu position is ALLOWED.
- The new position starts On-going -> adding again is BLOCKED again (re-locked).

prd_items.statement: When a user adds a company/position, the system SHALL accept the details once via the Watch List add form (fields: company, ISIN, amount, tenure, start month) and store ONE bonds master row per position, from which the monthly grid, dashboard, and watch list all render — the same details SHALL never be entered twice.

When a new position is added, the system SHALL allow at most ONE active (On-going or Danger) position per company: a duplicate SHALL be HARD BLOCKED with a named error (no override) if it matches an existing active position by normalized company name (trim/case-insensitive) OR by ISIN (either match blocks); the lock SHALL release only when the existing position reaches Completed (D5: months paid >= tenure), and a new position bought after Completed starts On-going and re-locks the company.
